stories.title: The Lantern Fox
stories.logline: A young fox who fears the dark guides a lost firefly home and finds the night is full of light.

scenes.title: Dusk at the den
scenes.synopsis: The sun sets and Fen, a young fox, will not leave the den.
scenes.script:
**EDGE OF THE WOOD — DUSK**

The sun slips behind the hill. FEN, a young fox, peers out of the den and pulls back in.

**FEN:** Just five more minutes of daylight?

**MOTHER FOX:** The night will not bite, little one.

scenes.title: A light in the grass
scenes.synopsis: A blinking light in the grass turns out to be Luma, a firefly who has lost her meadow.
scenes.script:
**THE TALL GRASS — NIGHT**

A small light blinks on, off, on. FEN creeps closer.

**LUMA:** Please — which way is the meadow? I was blown off course.

**FEN:** It is past the dark part of the wood.

Fen looks at the dark trees. Then at Luma.

scenes.title: The way home
scenes.synopsis: Fen walks Luma through the dark wood; the meadow lights up with hundreds of fireflies.
scenes.script:
**THE MEADOW — NIGHT**

Fen steps out of the trees. Hundreds of lights rise from the grass.

**LUMA:** You walked through the dark.

**FEN:** It was not so dark with you there.

panels.caption: Fen pulls back in
panels.dialogue: Just five more minutes of daylight?

panels.caption: The meadow lights up
panels.dialogue: It was not so dark with you there.

story_notes.title: Fen
story_notes.body: A young fox, curious by day and scared of the dark. Wants to be brave but does not know how yet.

story_notes.title: The meadow
story_notes.body: An open field past the dark wood where the fireflies live. Quiet by day, bright at night.

story_notes.title: Turning point
story_notes.body: Fen chooses to walk into the dark, not for himself, but to help someone else.
